description: This file defines a mock class for the IMediaPipelineServerInternalFactory interface, used for unit testing within the Rialto media server component. It includes mock methods for creating media pipeline objects and internal server objects, and references external interfaces and classes.

classes.name: MediaPipelineServerInternalFactoryMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of IMediaPipelineServerInternalFactory for testing purposes.

methods.name: createMediaPipeline
methods.description: Creates a mock media pipeline object with specified client and video requirements.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineServerInternal
methods.description: Creates a mock internal media pipeline server object with specified parameters including session ID, shared memory buffer, and decryption service.
